tokens.v: The board fills the frame corner to corner: dropped to case level so the low front lip reads as a razor line and the two-tone caps step away in a shallow ramp, the near off-white alpha row running out of both side edges, the knurled knob soft at top-right with one bright notch on its rim. Only two fingertips enter the picture - the index and middle of a right hand crossing the right frame edge, cropped at the middle knuckle so no palm, wrist, arm, cuff or any other part of the body is anywhere in frame - the index resting on one off-white alpha cap that sits visibly a millimetre below its neighbours, its backlight halo the brightest in frame. 100mm at f/4 from twenty centimetres out at case level, focus pinned on that pressed cap, the rear function row falling soft. Dim slate set late at night; one warm practical low at camera-right skims the anodised case into a single long highlight while the keyboard's own white backlight bleeds a thin halo under every blank cap. Dark desk crops to a finger's width at the top edge; the case runs out of the bottom. Let the case stand unmarked.
